A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DIME research. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison, including the new Appendix G in v2.

before.justification: v1 reports original DIME learning curves on 13 simulated control tasks, policy and hyperparameter ablations, and General Bridges experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains those empirical results and adds baseline comparisons, distributional-Q ablations, and measurements of learned diffusion coefficients.

M1.justification: DIME's defining KL objective, diffusion policy iteration, critic, autotuning, and Algorithm 1 are retained. Equation 27 corrects the expansion of the existing objective; Appendix G evaluates critic variants as ablations rather than introducing a redesigned method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 13 Gym, DMC, and MyoSuite environments listed in Table 1. Appendix G adds experiments on existing tasks without introducing new task requirements or environmental conditions.

E2.justification: DACER and QVPO, previously discussed but not evaluated, join the Ant-v3 and Humanoid-v3 comparisons in v2 Figure 3. Figure 8 additionally evaluates distributional-Q versions of Diff-QL and Consistency-AC, substantially expanding the relevant comparisons.

E3.justification: Appendix G adds controlled comparisons with distributional critics and Bellman-residual critics within existing tasks. Appendix E also changes Diff-QL's reported critic depth from three layers to two and BRO's entropy target from dim(A) to dim(A)/2. These reported setting revisions do not establish that earlier experiments were rerun; the main evaluation metrics and budgets remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v2 retains the temperature, diffusion-step, and Gaussian-policy ablations and adds substantial tests of whether performance depends on distributional Q learning across two Gym and four DMC dog tasks. Figure 7 also analyzes how four learned diffusion-coefficient components evolve during training.

E5.justification: Both versions specify ten seeds, interquartile means, and 95% stratified-bootstrap confidence intervals. The additional ten-seed reporting for the diffusion-coefficient plots does not introduce a new uncertainty-estimation practice or establish an increased run count.

E6.justification: The original learning curves are retained, but v2 adds substantial results in Figures 3 and 7–9. Figure 8 reports faster convergence than DACER to similar final Ant performance; without distributional Q, DIME matches DIPO/QVPO on Ant and exceeds the compared methods on Humanoid. Figure 9 reports a small distributional-Q benefit on dog tasks. These are additional comparisons and conditions, not improved scores for the original DIME runs.

T1.justification: Equation 6 corrects KL maximization to minimization, and Equation 27 corrects the transition conditionals in the KL expansion. The entropy-bound framework, finite-action assumption, propositions, and Appendix B proofs are otherwise retained; no new theorem is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the entropy-bound contribution, convergence claim, and broad performance claims, including the 13-task evaluation and superiority to Gaussian-policy methods on 10 tasks. Additional experiments support existing claims.

C2.justification: Appendix G newly qualifies the role of distributional Q: it provides a small additional benefit on dog tasks, while favorable comparisons persist without it. The earlier exploration-based explanation of diffusion-policy benefits and the main applicability discussion remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project-website pointer, explicitly identifies official baseline code releases as implementation sources, and documents DACER/QVPO hyperparameters. Core DIME implementation details remain stable. The reorganized tables omit QSM's previously listed Polyak weight.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds discussion of LSAC and latent-space policies, plus citations to additional offline diffusion-RL and diffusion-sampling work. The conclusion adds transformer critics as future work. These broaden context without redefining DIME's research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized language edits, reorganizes the experimental overview, renames Section 5.2, and adds Appendix G, acknowledgements, and an impact statement. Publication and affiliation text changes, but most prose and the main section sequence remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds three multi-panel figures, expands the Gym comparison plots and legends, and splits the hyperparameter table into diffusion and Gaussian comparisons. The temperature illustration moves from v1 Figure 6 in the appendix to v2 Figure 1 in the main text, with corrected target-density labels.

improvement.justification: The added DACER/QVPO comparisons and distributional-Q controls make the empirical case more convincing by addressing a specific ambiguity about critic choice. Corrections to Equations 6 and 27 improve mathematical consistency. These are useful, bounded improvements to an already extensive study; the core theory, task coverage, and original benchmark findings remain substantially unchanged.
